note: Every picture is graded (cool shadows, amber highlights), cropped to 16:9 or 4:5 and compressed to WebP. The sound is looped, and muffled for the inside of the bar. Adaptations of CC BY-SA works are shared under the same licence. The 3D people are Quaternius' CC0 base characters, dressed in code (the clothes, hats and glasses are cut from the body), except Mr. Based and the barman, whose models the owner supplied, and the furniture is Kenney's CC0 kit; all compressed (meshopt). The rooms, the street, the lamps and the rain are built in code.

items.title: Impact Sounds

items.changes: Footsteps on concrete, wood and carpet (tiles and wet stone made from them), glasses, a key, a stamp's thud; trimmed, levelled, some given a room.

items.title: Rain on the awning, the city far off, the lobby's clock, an old television, a siren, the bells, a match
items.author: made for the game
items.changes: Made for Mr. Based in code (numpy): the bar's door bell and the desk's, the television's hum and its switch, the two-tone siren, the traffic, the clock, the patter on the awning, the splash of a wet step.
